thread.title: If You Could Only Choose One Stock - Today's Editors' Picks

author: SA Editors' Picks
title: If You Could Only Choose One Stock - Today's Editors' Picks
text:
Three years ago, contributor Mike Nadel asked fifteen other Seeking Alpha authors what they believe is the best stock in the world. Today, he published an update analyzing the performance of their picks. The picks included Honeywell ( HON ), Berkshire Hathaway ( BRK.B ), Johnson & Johnson ( JNJ ), Gilead Sciences ( GILD ), Realty Income ( O ), Reynolds American ( BTI ), Cognizant Technology ( CTSH ), Coca-Cola ( KO ), Apple ( AAPL ), STAG Industrial ( STAG ), Disney ( DIS ), Kinder Morgan ( KMI ), Ventas ( VTR ), and Altria ( MO ). Can you guess which performed best since?
If you don’t already know, our Editors’ Picks represent what our editorial staff believes to be interesting and thorough analysis. Over the next few weeks, we’re going to experiment a bit with the format of this daily roundup. We are grateful to hear your opinions about how we can improve this offering in the comment section below.
Our contributors keep their ears to the ground and their eyes on the screen looking for profitable opportunities in the marketplace. Today, contributors Mike Nadel , Tristan R. Brown , Ian Bezek , Roger Nusbaum , and Silver Coast Research bring us some of the best ideas. Let us know which is your favorite in the comment section below.
Here are today’s Editors’ Picks:
A roundtable with author J Mintzmyer (SA Marketplace) An interview of the “one stock” question (Mike Nadel) Treasuries and equities (SA Multimedia) Retirement unreadiness (SA For FAs) Ethanol compromise comes to a head (Tristan R. Brown) S&P 500 on track for new all-time highs (Ian Bezek) Retirement math can be simple (Roger Nusbaum) Three stocks that thrive in volatile markets (Silver Coast Research) Chart of the day: Results of single stock showdown
Comment of the day, by contributor Buyandhold 2012
Interesting that only 7 of the stocks outperformed the S&P 500 over the last 3 years. Honeywell, British American Tobacco, Visa, Apple, Stag Industrials, Chevron and Berkshire Hathaway.
Also interesting that the panelist performed better on the second question than on the first question.
I said that if I could only own one stock it would be Johnson & Johnson which underperformed the S&P 500 by 5.3% during the past 3 years. Oddly enough, I do not own JNJ. But JNJ has outperformed SPY over the long term and is one of only two stocks with a AAA credit rating.
My timing with Gilead was a disaster. It has fallen 34.9% over the past 3 years. I don't own Gilead, either.
The stocks on the list that I do own are MO which is up 20.8% over the past 3 years, Disney down 1.5%, Medtronic up 16.4% and Exxon Mobil up 5.4%.
Congratulations to Adam for picking Honeywell and Berkshire Hathaway, both of which performed better than SPY over the last three years.
Image of the day: Are you ready for Solo?
Fun Fact Of The Day:
The Speedwell turned out to be a leaky ship, and so was unable to make the famous voyage with the Mayflower. Christopher Jones was the captain of the Mayflower when it took the Pilgrims to New England in 1620.
Thanks for reading. Please share your ‘Editor’s Pick’ with fellow investors by posting it in the comments.
Have a great day!
Jason
